final: WITH race_avgs AS (SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_avg_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId), country_avgs AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM race_avgs GROUP BY country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM country_avgs), group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(ca.avg_wins) AS group_avg FROM country_avgs ca CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.overall_avg) SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, ca.avg_wins - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, ca.avg_wins - g.group_avg AS above_group_avg FROM country_avgs ca CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN group_avg g WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.overall_avg AND ca.avg_wins > g.group_avg ORDER BY ca.country
